name: Sam and Nina Narodowski Undergraduate Scholarship for Migrants and Refugees
summary: $3,500 a semester for recently migrated RMIT undergraduates from non-English speaking backgrounds in education, health or social studies.
who: Australian citizen, permanent resident or permanent humanitarian visa holder.
Born overseas, recently migrated and from a non-English speaking background.
Enrolling full-time in an Education, Health Sciences, Medical Sciences or Global, Urban and Social Studies degree.
how: Apply direct to RMIT online (preferred) or through VTAC.

source.label: RMIT: Sam and Nina Narodowski Scholarship

evidence.quote: This scholarship provides $3,500 per semester for up to the standard full-time duration of your program.
be born overseas, recently migrated to Australia and from a non-English speaking background
